item.tib: byang chub sgrub thabs kyi bon tshigs su bcad pa sum brgya nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad gzhan phan snying po
item.coloph: snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun chen po yar me ba shes rab 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i byang chub sgrab thabs kyi bon tshigs su bcad pa sum brgya nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad gzhan phan snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer can gyi slob ma sde snod 'dzin pa hor tsha nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / ngag dbang rgyal mtshan sku mched gnyis kyis nan cher bskul nas brtsams pa la gzhir byas nas cung zad rgyas su btang ba 'di ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la gces spras su byed cing snying nas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i btsun pa gshen ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis legs par sbyar ba rdzogs so//
